@ with an .up~(4) and a .down~(2) a condition of the kind block resets once for each frame, before the first of its 2 runs
@ a condition of the kind block at the clock sample / 4 is read at the grid, before the runs of that position
@ a head with a stage of sample / 2: the stage that is slower than the condition writes first, the reset takes it back (S-1222)
